clipboard.name: Clipboard+
clipboard.desc: Auto-saves your clipboard history to paste anywhere, anytime.
clipboard.tagline: Auto-save every copy with the smartest clipboard manager for Android
clipboard.long: Clipboard+ is an Android clipboard manager that automatically saves every copied text and image in real time. A resizable floating overlay lets you reach your clipboard history from any screen without switching apps. Organize frequently used text into snippets and groups, and paste any clip fast with keyword search, a home screen widget, and a notification panel. You can also export your history to PDF and back up or restore your clips anytime. Pair it with Clipboard+ for Windows and what you copy on your phone pastes on your PC, and what you copy on your PC pastes on your phone. You just sign in to Google Drive with the same account in both apps, and your clips never pass through a CodeDAC server — they are stored only in your own Google Drive.
features: Auto-save copied text and images in real time
Resizable floating overlay for use over any app
Organize frequent text into snippets and groups
Instant search and filter by keyword, text, image, or date
Fast paste via widget, Quick Settings tile, and notification panel
Bidirectional phone-to-PC sync through your own Google Drive, export clipboard history to PDF, plus backup and restore

faq.q: How is my clipboard history saved?
faq.a: Every copied text and image is saved automatically in real time, so you can pull any clip back anytime without extra steps.

faq.q: Can I access my clipboard history while using other apps?
faq.a: Yes. A resizable floating overlay lets you reach your history from any screen without switching apps.

faq.q: Does it sync with my Windows PC?
faq.a: Yes. Install Clipboard+ for Windows as well, then in the settings of both apps sign in to Google Drive with the same account and turn on automatic sync. From then on, what you copy on your phone pastes on your PC, and what you copy on your PC pastes on your phone. Your clips never pass through a CodeDAC server — they are stored only in your own Google Drive.

autostart.name: AutoStart+
autostart.desc: Auto-launch your apps on boot. No root required, set once.
autostart.tagline: Auto start your apps the moment your phone boots. No root, set once, runs forever.
autostart.long: AutoStart+ is the easiest auto start manager for Android, launching your selected apps automatically the moment your device boots up, with no root required. Set it once and your apps launch at every startup without any manual tapping. The free version auto starts 1 app, while PRO unlocks unlimited apps launched in the order you choose. It notifies you if a launch fails, and guides you through the auto start settings on OEM devices like Samsung and Xiaomi.
features: Instantly auto-launches your selected apps on boot
Works on standard Android devices with no root required
Add installed apps in seconds and toggle each on or off with one tap
Smart boot notification alerts you if an app fails to launch
Boot overlay banner lets you launch apps before unlocking (PRO)
Auto start unlimited apps in your chosen order (PRO)

faq.q: My apps don't launch after boot. What should I do?
faq.a: Some manufacturers (Samsung, Xiaomi, and others) block app autostart on their own. Follow the in-app guide to complete the manufacturer-specific 'allow autostart' setting.

faq.q: How many apps can I auto start?
faq.a: The free version supports 1 app, while the PRO version lets you auto start an unlimited number of apps.

faq.q: Will it drain my battery?
faq.a: AutoStart+ runs only once at boot and is not an always-on background app, so it has almost no impact on battery life.

floatcalc.name: FloatCalc+
floatcalc.desc: A floating calculator with FX and unit converters, on top of any app.
floatcalc.tagline: Calculate without leaving your app — a floating calculator that stays on top.
floatcalc.long: FloatCalc+ is a floating calculator that stays on top of any app, so you never have to close your shopping, banking or browser screen just to work something out. The calculator, unit converter and currency converter share one draggable window: type an expression on the built-in number pad, get the answer instantly and copy it to the clipboard. Fold the keypad away when a single line is all you need, or shrink the whole panel to a floating icon that docks to the edge of the screen. Exchange rates come from the ECB and refresh daily, cached so everything keeps working offline. The floating calculator is free for 60 minutes a day — the time left is shown in the panel's title bar — and a short ad gets you a 24-hour pass when you need more.
features: Floats over any app — YouTube, maps, browser, banking, shopping, documents — and reopens in the mode you used last
One-tap operator row: + − × ÷ ( ) % right above the built-in number pad, with backspace to fix a single typo
Powers, roots and percentages — 2^10, √144, 100+10% — and the expression stays on screen after “=”, so a tap brings it back to edit
Unit converter inside the window: length, weight, temperature, area, volume, speed and time
Currency converter with daily ECB rates for 30+ currencies; Settings shows the date of the last update and its source
Fold the keypad down to one line or shrink the panel to an icon docked at the screen edge, with adjustable size, width, opacity and 8 themes

faq.q: Do I have to close my app every time I want to calculate?
faq.a: No. FloatCalc+ is a floating window that stays on top of other apps, so you can work out a discount or convert a price without leaving your shopping, banking or browser screen. Drag the window where you need it, get your answer, and carry on right where you were.

faq.q: Where do the exchange rates come from?
faq.a: From the European Central Bank, refreshed once a day. Settings › General shows the date the rates are from and their source, and updates them on demand. USD, EUR, JPY, GBP, KRW, CNY and 30+ world currencies convert right inside the overlay, and the daily cache keeps it working offline.

faq.q: How much can I use for free?
faq.a: The floating calculator is free for 60 minutes a day, and the panel's title bar shows how much of that is left. When you need more, watch a short ad for a 24-hour pass. Pro removes the daily time limit and the ads and adds the remaining unit categories and 30+ currencies, 7 premium themes and full panel customization (opacity, size, width), monthly, yearly or as a one-time lifetime purchase.

floatcrypto.name: FloatCrypto+
floatcrypto.desc: A live crypto ticker floating over any app, with alerts and charts.
floatcrypto.tagline: Keep Bitcoin, Ethereum and your altcoins on screen — above whatever app you are using.
floatcrypto.long: FloatCrypto+ floats a live crypto ticker on top of every app, so you can check the market while you watch YouTube, read the news or reply to messages — no switching, no reloading. Drag it anywhere, resize it and dial the opacity down so it never gets in the way. Set an upper or lower target and it notifies you the moment the market crosses it, keep a watchlist of the coins you actually follow, and open 1-day, 7-day and 30-day charts with period high, low, open and change. Prices come from Binance with an automatic fallback, so the ticker keeps working when one source is unreachable. Market data is delayed by up to 30 seconds — 10 seconds on Pro — and is for reference only, not investment advice.
features: Floating price ticker on top of every app — drag it anywhere, resize it, dial the opacity down
Price alerts on an upper or lower target, added straight from the coin card with the coin filled in
Watchlist of the coins you care about, with live price, 24-hour change and drag-to-reorder
1-day / 7-day / 30-day charts with period high, low, open and change
Eastern and Western color modes — green-up/red-down, or red-up/blue-down as read in Korea, Japan and China
Binance prices with an automatic fallback source, delayed by up to 30 seconds (10 on Pro)

faq.q: Can I see prices while using other apps?
faq.a: Yes. The ticker floats on top of every app, so you can watch the market while you are on YouTube, in a game or in a chat — no switching, no reloading. Drag it anywhere, resize it, and lower the opacity so it never covers what you are reading.

faq.q: How do price alerts work?
faq.a: Set an upper or lower target and FloatCrypto+ notifies you the moment the market crosses it. You can add an alert straight from a coin card — tap ⋮ and the coin is already filled in — and a bell badge marks every coin you are watching for.

faq.q: What do I get for free?
faq.a: Free follows 2 coins with 1 price alert and refreshes the ticker every 30 seconds. A Free Pass opens one feature for 24 hours in exchange for one short ad — the Chart pass unlocks the 7-day and 30-day charts, the Watchlist pass gives 10 coins and unlimited alerts — one of each per day, for as many days as you like, and ads keep running while a pass is active. Pro gives 10 coins, unlimited alerts, a 10-second refresh, the full chart history and no ads, monthly, annually or as a one-time lifetime purchase.

floattimer.name: FloatTimer+
floattimer.desc: A floating timer, counter and stopwatch that stays over any app.
floattimer.tagline: A countdown timer, tally counter, and stopwatch that floats on top of every app.
floattimer.long: FloatTimer+ is a floating overlay app that keeps a countdown timer, tally counter, and stopwatch on top of any app you use. Your timer stays visible while you do something else — drag it anywhere on screen, set size, opacity, and background color per item, or fold it into a compact chip when you need the screen back. Play, pause, and reset straight from the overlay menu without opening the app, and everything keeps running in the background even when you switch apps or lock the screen. Set it once and keep cooking, exercising, studying, or gaming without ever losing sight of the time.
features: Floating overlay — timers, counters, and stopwatches float on any app; drag them anywhere and set size, opacity, and background color per item
Multi-timer — any hours/minutes/seconds countdown, with 1, 5, 10, 25, 30 and 60-minute quick presets and as many timers running at once as you like
Overlay controls — play, pause, and reset from the overlay menu without opening the app, or fold it into a compact chip and tap to expand
Tally counter — tap to count up or down right on the overlay, with a step of 1, 2, 5, or 10 and as many counters as you need
Stopwatch — several stopwatches, each timed separately; start, pause, and reset without leaving your current app
Alerts and backup — sound, vibration, or a full-screen alert when time is up, plus file export and restore that merges or replaces

faq.q: Does the timer stay visible while I use other apps?
faq.a: Yes. The timer, counter, and stopwatch float on top of any app and run in the background, so they keep going even when you switch apps or lock the screen.

faq.q: Can I use it as a Pomodoro or workout timer?
faq.a: Yes. Quick presets include 25 minutes, you can set any duration you like, and you can run several timers at once for work and rest rounds. Pro repeats a timer 2, 3, or 5 times, or endlessly.

faq.q: What does the free version include?
faq.a: Unlimited timers, counters, and stopwatches, with no daily time limit. The only free limit is one floating overlay at a time — Pro shows as many as you like at once, or you can watch a short ad for a 24-hour Free Pass.

volumebooster.name: VolumeBooster+
volumebooster.desc: Volume booster, equalizer and bass boost — make any sound louder, up to +15 dB.
volumebooster.tagline: Make every app louder — up to +15 dB, shown in real decibels with safe-range guidance.
volumebooster.long: Is your phone too quiet? VolumeBooster+ raises your entire system output rather than one app — quiet speakers, low earphones, hard-to-hear videos, calls, music and games finally come through clearly. The boost is shown in decibels, up to +15 dB, with Safe / Caution / Danger zones based on WHO hearing guidance, so you always see how far you have pushed it. Free reaches +10 dB, and Pro or a Free Pass opens the full range. A Loudness Maximizer, a 5-band equalizer whose nine presets are all free, a bass booster, a 3D virtualizer and AutoEQ correction built on 2,456 measured headphone profiles all live in the same app.
features: System-wide boost up to +15 dB with Safe / Caution / Danger labels — +10 dB free, the full range with Pro or a Free Pass
Loudness Maximizer with multiband compression, makeup gain and an always-on peak limiter — genuinely louder, with no clipping or distortion
5-band Equalizer with 9 presets, all free: Flat, Pop, Rock, Vocal, Classical, EDM, Movie, Gaming and Night Mode
Bass Booster, 3D Virtualizer and AutoEQ — 2,456 measured headphone profiles across 357 brands, with mainstream brands (Apple, Samsung, Sony, Bose, JBL, Beats) free
Floating Panel free for everyone, plus hearing protection stats (Pro), a sleep timer with fade-out, L/R channel balance, a Quick Settings tile, a home-screen widget and notification controls
Free Pass — one short ad for 24 hours of Max Boost or AutoEQ; otherwise free boosting runs 60 minutes a day and resets at midnight

faq.q: Does it really make my phone louder?
faq.a: Yes. The Loudness Maximizer uses multiband compression and makeup gain to genuinely increase perceived loudness, and it raises the whole system output rather than one app — music, videos, YouTube, games and calls alike. Free boosts up to +10 dB, and Pro or a Free Pass opens the full +15 dB range.

faq.q: Is it actually free, or do I need a subscription?
faq.a: Free gives you up to +10 dB, all 9 presets, the 5-band equalizer, the floating panel and AutoEQ for mainstream brands like Apple, Samsung, Sony, Bose, JBL and Beats — with free boosting limited to 60 minutes a day, resetting at midnight. A Free Pass adds 24 hours of Max Boost (the full +15 dB range with no daily limit) or AutoEQ (the complete headphone catalogue) for a single short ad, with no card and no trial to cancel. Pro unlocks the full range, unlimited boost time, every AutoEQ profile and the hearing protection dashboard, and removes ads — monthly, yearly or as a one-time lifetime purchase.

faq.q: Is the displayed dB an exact measurement?
faq.a: It is an estimate. The boost is shown in real decibels with WHO-based Safe, Caution and Danger zones, but the value is derived from your system volume and the applied gain, and real loudness varies by device, headphones and content. The app is not a medical device, so if you notice ear pain or ringing, lower the volume and consult a professional.

photocleaner.name: PhotoCleaner+
photocleaner.desc: Hide personal info in photos & PDFs, fully on-device.
photocleaner.tagline: Hide personal info in photos and PDFs with a solid mask, entirely on your device.
photocleaner.long: PhotoCleaner+ hides personal information in photos and PDFs entirely on your device. It covers sensitive areas with a solid, opaque mask (not a blur or mosaic, so covered areas can't be recovered) and exports a clean copy. A built-in detector suggests likely sensitive text such as ID numbers, cards, phone numbers, and emails as a starting point, but you draw and adjust masks by hand to decide exactly what gets hidden. No photo is ever uploaded, everything runs offline, and no gallery or storage permission is ever requested.
features: Solid opaque mask that can't be recovered (not a blur or mosaic)
Draw masks by hand, then move, resize or delete them, with zoom for precision
Built-in detection suggests likely sensitive text (ID numbers, cards, phones, emails) to get you started
Mask photos, ID cards and multi-page PDF documents
EXIF & GPS notice, and every saved or shared copy is re-encoded with no EXIF
Zero permissions, and clean image export with no watermark for everyone

faq.q: Is the masking a blur or mosaic?
faq.a: No. Masking uses one style only, a solid opaque fill, and covered areas can't be recovered. With Pro you can pick any mask color.

faq.q: Are my photos uploaded anywhere?
faq.a: No. Everything runs offline on your device and no photo is ever uploaded. The app also never requests gallery or storage permission.

faq.q: Can I rely on auto-detection alone before exporting?
faq.a: Detection is only a starting point that suggests likely sensitive text. Always review the suggestions and add or remove masks yourself before exporting.

readfocus.name: ReadFocus+
readfocus.desc: A dyslexia & ADHD reading aid with line highlight & mask.
readfocus.tagline: A dyslexia & ADHD reading aid: line highlight and reading mask keep your eyes on track and ease eye strain.
readfocus.long: ReadFocus+ is a reading ruler, reading mask and reading aid for dyslexia and ADHD on Android. Grant the overlay permission once and a translucent focus strip floats on top of any app — ebook readers, browsers, PDF, news, comics — keeping your eyes on the line you're reading. It reduces skipping or re-reading the same row, easing eye strain and boosting reading concentration and efficiency.
features: Line Highlight (Reading Ruler): illuminates your current line to keep eyes on track
Reading Mask: dims everything except your reading zone for tunnel-vision focus
Fully adjustable focus strip: height (50dp–300dp) and opacity (10%–100%)
10 color themes (3 free + 7 Pro)
Works on top of any app — ebooks, PDF, webtoons, news, research papers
Pro: ad-free experience, unlimited overlay time, and keep screen on while reading

faq.q: How does ReadFocus+ work?
faq.a: Grant the overlay permission once and a semi-transparent focus strip floats on top of any app. Drag it to the line you're reading and your eyes stay on track instead of wandering or skipping rows.

faq.q: Which apps does it work with?
faq.a: It works on top of any app on screen — ebook and PDF readers, research papers, web articles, blogs, news, study notes, textbooks, comics, webtoons, and long emails or chat history.

faq.q: Is it free to use?
faq.a: Yes. The free version gives 60 minutes of overlay time per session and 3 color themes. Pro adds an ad-free experience, all 10 themes, and unlimited overlay time — and you can also watch a short rewarded ad to unlock any Pro feature free for 24 hours.

floatnote.name: FloatNote+
floatnote.desc: Sticky notes that float over any app. Collapse to a chip, expand to a card, with colors and rich text.
floatnote.tagline: Sticky notes that float over any app! Jot down a thought and it stays on your screen, always one tap away.
floatnote.long: FloatNote+ keeps sticky notes floating on top of any app. Grant the overlay permission once and every note lives as a small chip above your browser, chat, video or home screen; tap it and the chip expands into a full card you can read, edit and share on the spot. Colors, rich text and inline images keep each note distinct, while the main app works as a library for searching, pinning and reordering. Light and dark themes are both included. Pair it with FloatNote+ for Windows and notes written on your phone show up on your PC, and notes written on your PC show up on your phone. You just sign in to Google Drive with the same account in both apps, and your notes never pass through a CodeDAC server — they are stored only in your own Google Drive.
features: Floating overlay notes: collapse a note to a chip, expand it to a full card over any app
7 sticky-note colors and rich text: bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, text color and size
Inline images: attach photos right inside a note
Quick capture from the share sheet, from selected text in any app, or from the Quick Settings tile
Library with instant search, pinning and drag-to-reorder — dragging a chip to the bottom zone stashes the note instead of deleting it
Pro: unlimited floating notes, all 7 colors, inline images, adjustable opacity, Google Drive sync, export & import, no ads

faq.q: How do floating notes work?
faq.a: Grant the overlay permission once and your notes float above other apps as small chips. Tap a chip to expand it into a card and edit it right there; tap outside and it collapses back, saving automatically. Dragging a chip to the zone at the bottom of the screen only stashes the note — real deletion always asks for confirmation.

faq.q: Where can I use it?
faq.a: Anywhere on screen — over a browser, a chat, a video, a document or the home screen. You can also create a note without opening the app: from the share sheet, from text you select in another app, or from the Quick Settings tile.

faq.q: Does it sync with my Windows PC?
faq.a: Yes. Install FloatNote+ for Windows as well, then in the settings of both apps sign in to Google Drive with the same account and turn on automatic sync. Notes written on your phone then show up on your PC, and notes written on your PC show up on your phone. Your notes never pass through a CodeDAC server — they are stored only in your own Google Drive. Images attached to a note stay on the device they were added on; what travels is the note text.

faq.q: Is it free?
faq.a: Yes. Saving notes is unlimited and free, and the free version floats sticky notes with 2 colors and shows ads. Pro adds unlimited floating notes, all 7 colors, inline images, adjustable opacity, Google Drive sync, export and import, and removes ads.

clipboardwin.name: Clipboard+ for Windows
clipboardwin.desc: A Windows tray clipboard manager that syncs with the Clipboard+ Android app.
clipboardwin.tagline: A Windows tray clipboard manager that syncs with your Android phone through your own Google Drive.
clipboardwin.long: Clipboard+ for Windows is a tray-resident clipboard manager that automatically saves the text and images you copy. Everything is recorded the moment you copy it, so even if you overwrite something by accident you can pull the earlier item back and paste it. Pair it with the Android Clipboard+ app and what you copy on your phone pastes on your PC, and what you copy on your PC pastes on your phone. Your clips never pass through a CodeDAC server — they are stored only in your own Google Drive. Saved items can be organized into groups and snippets and searched.
features: Sits in the tray and saves text and images the moment you copy them — it never has to keep checking in the background, so it stays light
Bidirectional phone-to-PC sync through your own Google Drive
Android-style UI with light/dark themes, group sidebar, snippets, and pin/copy/edit/search
Multi-select bulk move, delete, and merge, newest/oldest sorting, and a full-size image viewer
Global hotkeys to open the window and instantly capture text selected in other apps, plus run-at-startup
Export/import compatible with the Android Clipboard+ backup format

faq.q: Does it sync with the Android Clipboard+ app?
faq.a: Yes. Turn on sync with the same Google account on both devices, and what you copy on your phone pastes on your PC, and what you copy on your PC pastes on your phone. Your clips never pass through a CodeDAC server — they travel only through your own Google Drive.

faq.q: Where is my clipboard data stored, and is it safe?
faq.a: Your clip history is kept on your PC by default (in the %APPDATA%\ClipboardPlus folder). If you turn on sync, it is also stored in a private app area of your own Google Drive — an area that stays hidden from your Drive view and cannot be opened by anything other than Clipboard+. The app uses only that private area, so it cannot reach any of your other photos or documents on Drive.

faq.q: What do I need to enable sync?
faq.a: In the settings of both the Android app and the Windows app, sign in to Google Drive with the same account, then turn on automatic sync. From then on, the clipboards on both devices stay in sync on their own.

readfocuswin.name: ReadFocus+ for Windows
readfocuswin.desc: A click-through focus strip for Windows — Mask and Highlight keep your eyes on the line.
readfocuswin.tagline: A tray-resident focus strip for Windows: Mask or Highlight keeps your eyes on the line, and every click passes straight through to the app underneath.
readfocuswin.long: ReadFocus+ for Windows is the desktop version of the Android ReadFocus+ app. It lays a calm focus strip over whatever you are reading — a web page, a PDF, a document, code — so it is easier to stay on the line. Mask gently dims the top and bottom of the screen and leaves a clear band across the middle; Highlight marks the line you are on with a soft tinted strip. The Focus Strip is click-through, so you keep scrolling, selecting and clicking underneath exactly as before, and a small floating panel switches modes, moves or locks the band and hides it away without making you leave what you are reading.
features: Two reading modes — Mask dims everything outside a clear band, Highlight marks the line you are on
Click-through: keep scrolling, selecting and clicking the app underneath — nothing intercepts your mouse
A floating panel to switch mode, move or lock the strip and hide it, collapsing to a single row when you do not need it
Keyboard shortcuts for start and stop, mode, show and hide, lock, and nudging the strip up or down
Multi-monitor: the reading band follows the panel to whichever screen you move it to, and waits in the system tray until you need it
No ads. Pro is a one-time purchase: premium themes, Focus Strip settings, Keep Screen On, and no time limit

faq.q: Is this the same app as ReadFocus+ on Android?
faq.a: It is the same app built for Windows, with the same two reading modes. The two are bought separately on their own stores, and there is nothing to sync — ReadFocus+ never stores what you read.

faq.q: Which apps does it work with?
faq.a: Any app on screen: browsers, PDF and ebook readers, documents, code editors, research papers, and long emails or chat logs. The Focus Strip is drawn on top of the screen, so the app underneath does not have to support anything.

faq.q: Is it free to use?
faq.a: Yes. The free version reads in sessions of up to 60 minutes and includes both reading modes and three of the ten themes. Pro is a one-time purchase — not a subscription — and adds premium themes, Focus Strip settings (height, opacity) and Keep Screen On, and removes the time limit. The Windows version has no ads.

floatnotewin.name: FloatNote+ for Windows
floatnotewin.desc: Sticky notes that float over any window on Windows, syncing with the FloatNote+ Android app.
floatnotewin.tagline: Sticky notes that float on top of whatever you are working in: write without leaving the window you are in, and they never steal its focus.
floatnotewin.long: FloatNote+ for Windows is the desktop version of the Android FloatNote+ app. Every note lives as a small chip above your browser, your editor or your spreadsheet; click it and it expands into a card right there, ready to read or edit, and Esc folds it back into a chip. A chip never takes focus from the app behind it, so whatever you were typing stays exactly as it was — and there is no save button, since every keystroke is committed for you. Seven pastel colors, rich text and inline images keep notes apart, a library window handles search, pinning and management, and optional sync moves your notes through an app-private folder in your own Google Drive, the same one the Android app uses.
features: Sticky notes that float above every window: a chip expands into an editable card in place, and Esc folds it back
Never steals focus — drag or click a chip and your cursor stays in the app you were typing in
No save button: every keystroke is committed for you, and a library window handles search, pinning and management
Rich text — bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, text color and size — with 7 pastel note colors and inline images
Bidirectional phone-to-PC sync through your own Google Drive — the same app-private folder the Android app uses, and never a CodeDAC server
Global hotkeys, system tray, light and dark themes, run at logon, 21 languages. No ads, and Pro is a one-time purchase

faq.q: Is this the same app as FloatNote+ on Android?
faq.a: It is the same app built for Windows, with the same chips and cards. You buy each one in its own store, but once you sign in to Google Drive with the same account in both apps and turn on automatic sync, notes written on the PC show up on the phone and notes written on the phone show up on the PC. Your notes never pass through a CodeDAC server — they are stored only in your own Google Drive. Images attached to a note stay on the device they were added on; what travels is the note text.

faq.q: Does it get in the way of the app underneath?
faq.a: No. A chip is a floating window that never takes focus, so clicking or dragging one leaves your cursor exactly where you were typing. Click a chip to expand the card, press Esc or click elsewhere and it folds back, already saved.

faq.q: Is it free to use?
faq.a: Yes. Writing and storing notes is free and unlimited, and the Windows version has no ads. The free version floats one note on screen at a time and gives you two of the seven colors. Pro is a one-time purchase — not a subscription — and adds unlimited floating notes, the full palette, inline images, adjustable note transparency, Google Drive sync, and note export and import.

floattimerwin.name: FloatTimer+ for Windows
floattimerwin.desc: Timers, counters and stopwatches that float over any window on Windows as small pastel cards.
floattimerwin.tagline: Timers, counters and stopwatches that float on top of whatever you are working in: small pastel cards you drag where you want them, and they never steal focus from the app underneath.
floattimerwin.long: FloatTimer+ for Windows is the desktop version of the Android FloatTimer+ app. Instead of a window you have to switch to, each timer becomes a small pastel card floating above your work — your editor, your browser, your video call — counting down in plain sight. Click a card to start or pause it, drag it wherever it belongs, or fold it into a chip when you want the screen back. The card never takes focus from the app behind it, so your cursor stays exactly where you left it while you type. Counters add and subtract with a click on either half, stopwatches count up, and nine pastel colors keep them apart. features: Timers, counters and stopwatches float above every window as small pastel cards — drag one anywhere, resize it, or fold it into a chip
Never steals focus — click or drag a card and your cursor stays in the document you were typing in
Start, pause and reset from the card itself without opening the app; counters add and subtract with a click on either half
Nine pastel colors, adjustable card size and opacity, and app windows that follow your light or dark theme

Global hotkeys, system tray, run at logon, 21 languages. No account, no network, no ads — and Pro is a one-time purchase

faq.q: Is this the same app as FloatTimer+ on Android?
faq.a: It is the same app built for Windows, with the same floating cards. You buy each one in its own store. The two do not sync automatically, but they read and write the same backup file, so you can move your list between them by exporting on one and restoring on the other.

faq.q: Does it get in the way of the app underneath?
faq.a: No. A card is a floating window that never takes focus, so clicking or dragging it leaves your cursor exactly where you were typing. When you want the screen back, fold a card into a small chip, or hide every card at once with a hotkey.

faq.q: Is it free to use?
faq.a: Yes. You can make as many timers, counters and stopwatches as you like — the list is never limited — and the Windows version has no ads. The free version floats one card on screen at a time. Pro is a one-time purchase — not a subscription — and adds unlimited floating cards, repeating timers, any color you like, and your own alert sound or a full-screen alert.
